nota: FICTION. Aliens only appear in Fantasy and Horror modes, at night and during the countdown. They mostly pressure your resources: they force you to spend power on light and to fix leaks.

abductor.consejo: ABDUCTOR: take shelter in the light (habitat or towers) or hit it with ACTION.

rastreador.consejo: TRACKER: drawn to the heat of powered modules. Switch them off (Base) or light them up.

saboteador.consejo: SABOTEUR: runs to bite tanks and the habitat. If it gets there, it causes a leak.

nodriza.consejo: MOTHERSHIP! It attacks the rocket during the countdown. Hit it and keep light towers on near the rocket.
